steps.label: Extract / translate
steps.note: Heuristic extract + glossary translate. Intentionally leaves 플스 nicknames unmatched and leaks Hangul on two bodies so the CP gate has real work.

reviews.body_source: 비염이랑 낮은 코 같이. 상담이 안정적이었고 당일 일상 가능. 후유증 없고 주변 추천함.
reviews.body_en: Rhinitis plus a low bridge. Consult felt steady, daily life the same day. No lingering issues. I would recommend it.

reviews.body_source: Lip filler. Conservative, which I asked for. Bruising for five days. They refused extra volume when I got greedy mid-appointment, respect for that.
reviews.body_en: Lip filler. Conservative, which I asked for. Bruising for five days. They refused extra volume when I got greedy mid-appointment, respect for that.

reviews.body_source: 첫 코. 보형물 싫어서 자가연골. 아픔은 이틀. 옆라인이 제일 마음에 듦.
reviews.body_en: First nose. Refused an implant, used own cartilage. Pain for two days. The profile line is what I like most.

reviews.body_source: 팔자주름 필러. 과하지 않게. 이틀 부음. 마사지하지 말라는 안내가 큼지막해서 좋았음.
reviews.body_en: Nasolabial filler, kept conservative. Two days of swelling. Big printed sign not to massage — useful.

reviews.body_source: Rhinoplasty while in Seoul for work. Consult felt salesy at first then the surgeon took over and it got technical, which I wanted. Bridge is subtle. Tip still a bit stiff at week six. Translation during surgery consent was rushed.
reviews.body_en: Rhinoplasty while in Seoul for work. Consult felt salesy at first then the surgeon took over and it got technical, which I wanted. Bridge is subtle. Tip still a bit stiff at week six. Translation during surgery consent was rushed.

reviews.body_source: 상안검이랑 눈매교정 같이. 졸려 보이던 눈이 또렷해짐. 과교정 걱정했는데 자연스러움. 실밥 제거 때 대기 길었음.
reviews.body_en: Upper blepharoplasty plus ptosis repair. Sleepy eyes look more open. I worried about overcorrection; it still looks like me. Long wait at stitch removal.

reviews.body_source: 광대 축소. 입안 절개. 식사 일주일 힘듦. 정면 변화는 남들이 모름, 본인만 앎. 그게 목적.
reviews.body_en: Zygoma reduction, intraoral incision. Eating was hard for a week. Front-view change is something only I notice, which was the point.

reviews.body_source: 복부 지방흡입. 압박복 진짜 힘듦. 체중보다 라인이 목적. 한 달 후 유니폼이 편해짐. 멍이 넓게 가서 일주일은 티 났음.
reviews.body_en: Abdominal liposuction. The compression garment is the hard part. Goal was shape, not the scale. Uniforms fit better at one month. Bruising was wide for a week.

reviews.body_source: Flew from Sydney for zygoma and genioplasty at ID. Coordinator answered emails in actual English, not templates. Swelling was brutal for three weeks. At month three the 45-degree view finally looks like the morph. Anesthesia team was the part I cared about most and they were present the whole case.
reviews.body_en: Flew from Sydney for zygoma and genioplasty at ID. Coordinator answered emails in actual English, not templates. Swelling was brutal for three weeks. At month three the 45-degree view finally looks like the morph. Anesthesia team was the part I cared about most and they were present the whole case.

reviews.body_source: 사각턱 축소. 전신마취 깨는 게 힘들었고 유동식 일주일이 지옥. 두 달 지나니 얼굴 선이 정리됨. 신경 손상 얘기 미리 들어서 감각 둔한 건 놀랍지 않았음.
reviews.body_en: Square-jaw reduction. Waking from general anesthesia was rough and a week of liquids was miserable. At two months the line is cleaner. They warned about nerve numbness so the dull sensation was not a surprise.

reviews.body_source: 매몰로 쌍꺼풀 했어요. 상담이 길었고 라인 높이도 여러 번 확인했습니다. 풀릴 수 있다고 미리 말해서 좋았어요. 한쪽이 조금 덜 접히는데 한 달 더 보기로 했습니다.
reviews.body_en: Buried-suture double eyelid. Long consult, they checked crease height several times. They warned it can loosen, which I appreciated. One side folds a little less — we will recheck in a month.

reviews.body_source: Pico plus booster while waiting out a rhino consult elsewhere. Skin tone evened out in two weeks. Not a miracle, just competent. Front desk handled card in USD without drama.
reviews.body_en: Pico plus booster while waiting out a rhino consult elsewhere. Skin tone evened out in two weeks. Not a miracle, just competent. Front desk handled card in USD without drama.

reviews.body_source: 코재수술 세 번째라 포기할 뻔. 정현우 원장이 연골 상태 설명하고 욕심내지 말라고 함. 숨이 트이고 정면 라인이 안정적. 재수술은 여기로 정착.
reviews.body_en: Third revision — I almost quit. Dr. Jung Hyun-woo explained the cartilage situation and told me not to get greedy. Breathing is open and the front line is stable. This is where I stop shopping around.

reviews.body_source: Second nose. First was in California and collapsed. Dr. Lee used rib cartilage. Breathing is the win, appearance is a close second. Hotel recovery was harder than the OR. Would fly back for this clinic only.
reviews.body_en: Second nose. First was in California and collapsed. Dr. Lee used rib cartilage. Breathing is the win, appearance is a close second. Hotel recovery was harder than the OR. Would fly back for this clinic only.

reviews.body_source: 사각턱 보톡스. 효과는 3주부터. 씹을 때 힘이 빠져서 처음엔 적응 필요. 가격 투명하고 리터치 정책 있음. 주사 자체는 빨리 끝.
reviews.body_en: Masseter botox. Effect from week three. Chewing felt weak at first. Pricing is transparent and they have a retouch policy. The injections were quick.

reviews.body_source: 코가 낮아서 상담 받고 기증연골로 콧대 올렸어요. 김민준 원장님이 무리하지 말라고 하셔서 오히려 믿음이 갔습니다. 수술 당일부터 일상은 가능했고 붓기는 열흘 정도. 사진 각도만 아니면 티 안 납니다.
reviews.body_en: Low bridge — I had a consult and they raised it with donated cartilage. Dr. Kim Min-jun told me not to overdo the design, which actually made me trust him. Daily life was possible the same day; swelling lasted about ten days. Unless you catch a certain angle, it does not look operated.

reviews.body_source: SMAS 거상. 회복이 길다, 진짜 길다. 세 달 지나니 턱선이 살아남. 흉터는 귀 뒤에 가려짐. 기대치를 낮추고 가라.
reviews.body_en: SMAS facelift. Recovery is long, actually long. At three months the jawline is back. Scar hides behind the ear. Lower your expectations and then go.

reviews.body_source: 구축 코 재건. 보형물 빼고 자가연골. 통증은 이틀, 모양은 한 달부터 보기 좋음. 코만 보는 클리닉이라 대기 없음.
reviews.body_en: Contracted-nose reconstruction. Implant out, own cartilage in. Pain for two days, shape looked decent from week four. Nose-only clinic, no waiting room circus.

reviews.body_source: 타 병원 보형물 구축으로 재수술. 보형물 제거하고 자가조직으로 재건. 호흡이 이전보다 편함. 재수술은 돈도 시간도 두 배라는 거 실감. 결과는 기대 이상.
reviews.body_en: Revision after implant contracture at another clinic. Implant out, rebuilt with own tissue. Breathing is easier. Revision really is twice the money and time. Result is better than I expected.

reviews.body_source: 코만 하는 곳이라 그런지 상담이 디테일함. 비중격이랑 외형 같이 봄. 호흡이 목적의 절반이었는데 실제로 밤에 덜 막힘. 붓기는 2주.
reviews.body_en: A nose-only clinic, and the consult was detailed. They looked at septum and appearance together. Breathing was half the goal — nights are less blocked. Swelling about two weeks.

reviews.body_source: Non-incisional double eyelid. Left eye crease sat higher than the right after two months. Revision offered at a discount, still deciding. Clinic is busy and I felt processed. Results are fine from the front, uneven in photos.
reviews.body_en: Non-incisional double eyelid. Left eye crease sat higher than the right after two months. Revision offered at a discount, still deciding. Clinic is busy and I felt processed. Results are fine from the front, uneven in photos.

reviews.body_source: Forehead botox. Fine. Waited 50 minutes past appointment. Result is smooth without the frozen look. Would go again if they ran on time.
reviews.body_en: Forehead botox. Fine. Waited 50 minutes past appointment. Result is smooth without the frozen look. Would go again if they ran on time.

reviews.body_source: Primary rhino at Honesty. They spent forty minutes on my breathing, not the Instagram angle. Cast off at day 8, still puffy. I liked that they said no to alar reduction.
reviews.body_en: Primary rhino at Honesty. They spent forty minutes on my breathing, not the Instagram angle. Cast off at day 8, still puffy. I liked that they said no to alar reduction.

reviews.body_source: 기능 코성형. 외형보다 숨. 코골이가 줄었다고 가족이 먼저 말함. 회복은 순한 편.
reviews.body_en: Functional rhinoplasty. Breathing over appearance. Family noticed less snoring before I did. Recovery was mild.

reviews.body_source: 팝성형외과에서 콧대랑 끝만 다듬었어요. 과한 서양코 싫다고 했더니 디자인 다시 그려주심. 일주일 뒤에 실밥 제거하고 코 풀기 아직 조심 중. 직원 응대가 빠르고 통역은 없었는데 저흰 한국어라 상관없음.
reviews.body_en: Pop Plastic Surgery, bridge and tip only. I said I did not want a Western nose and they redrew the plan. Stitches out at one week, still careful about blowing my nose. Staff replies fast. No interpreter; we did not need one.

reviews.body_source: 눈밑 지방 재배치. 멍이 생각보다 오래 가서 2주는 선글라스 필수였음. 결과는 만족, 다크서클이 덜해 보임. 가격은 상담 때랑 조금 달라서 4점.
reviews.body_en: Lower-eyelid fat repositioning. Bruising lasted longer than I expected — sunglasses for two weeks. Happy with the result, dark circles look lighter. Price shifted a bit from the consult, so four stars.

reviews.body_source: 에잇에서 콧대만. 짧은 수술, 짧은 회복. 티 안 나게 해달라고 했더니 정말 티 안 남. 주변에서 살 빠진 거 아니냐고만 물어봄.
reviews.body_en: Bridge-only at Eight. Short surgery, short recovery. I asked for undetectable and it is. People only ask if I lost weight.

reviews.body_source: 눈꺼풀 두꺼워서 절개로 갔습니다. 최원장님이 근육이랑 지방 얼마나 뺄지 스케치로 보여줌. 흉터는 쌍꺼풀 안에 숨겨짐. 쌍수 고민하는 분들 여기 상담만이라도 가보세요.
reviews.body_en: Thick lids so I went incisional. Dr. Choi sketched how much muscle and fat to take. Scar sits inside the crease. If you are considering double eyelid, take the consult here even if you operate elsewhere.

reviews.body_source: 매몰 쌍꺼풀 당일 수술. 붓기 사흘. 라인 얇게 해달라고 해서 직장 눈치 거의 없음.
reviews.body_en: Same-day buried-suture double eyelid. Swelling for three days. I asked for a thin crease and work did not notice.

reviews.body_source: 실리프팅. 당기는 느낌은 일주일. 효과는 미미. 스킨부스터랑 같이 권유받아서 좀 부담. 시술 자체는 위생적.
reviews.body_en: Thread lift. The tight feeling lasted a week. Effect is modest. They pushed a booster add-on, which felt heavy. Hygiene was fine.

rejected.body_source: 광대랑 턱끝 같이 했어요. 붓기가 세 달째 조금 남음. 정면은 좋은데 사각에서 아직 어색. 회복 설명을 더 자세히 해줬으면 좋았을 듯. 수술은 깔끔하다고 생각함.
rejected.body_en: Zygoma and chin together. Still a little swollen at month three. Front view is good, three-quarter still looks off. Wish recovery had been explained in more detail. The surgery itself felt clean. 원장님 추천이요.

rejected.body_source: 스킨부스터 3회 패키지 중 1회 끝. 바늘 자국이 많음. 다음날 화장 가능. 광은 생겼는데 효과는 아직 판단 보류. 직원 영어 가능해서 외국인 친구 데려가기 좋음.
rejected.body_en: First of three skin-booster sessions. Lots of needle marks. Makeup the next day. There is a glow; too early to judge. Staff speak English, easy to bring a foreign friend. 원장님 추천이요.

rejected.body_source: 최고였음. 별점 칸이 이상하게 6까지 눌림. 코 모양 만족.
rejected.body_en: It was excellent. The star widget let me hit 6 somehow. Happy with the nose.

rejected.body_source: 대기만 두 시간. 본문 작성 중 별점이 0으로 저장됨. 수술은 아직 안 함. 상담만.
rejected.body_en: Two-hour wait. Stars saved as 0 while I was still writing. Have not had surgery, consult only.

rejected.body_source: 재수술 만족. 별점 UI가 해외 리뷰 양식이라 7점까지 열린 듯.
rejected.body_en: Happy with the revision. Their star UI looks like a foreign form and opened up to 7.

rejected.body_source: Good primary rhino. I wanted 4.5, the slider stuck at 4.25. Tip still swollen at week four.
rejected.body_en: Good primary rhino. I wanted 4.5, the slider stuck at 4.25. Tip still swollen at week four.

rejected.body_source: Scheduled for December. Writing this after the consult so I do not forget the quote. Bridge implant vs cartilage still undecided.
rejected.body_en: Scheduled for December. Writing this after the consult so I do not forget the quote. Bridge implant vs cartilage still undecided.

rejected.body_source: 1월 수술 예정인데 후기 칸이 열려서 상담 후기만 남김. 보형물 사이즈는 아직.
rejected.body_en: Surgery is booked for January; the review box was already open so this is consult-only. Implant size still undecided.

rejected.body_source: 겨울에 레이저 받으려고 예약만 함. 후기가 먼저 올라감.
rejected.body_en: Booked laser for winter. The review posted before the appointment.

rejected.body_source: 이벤트 이름으로 적혀 있어서 뭔 시술인지 모르겠음. 윤곽 상담만 받고 옴.
rejected.body_en: Listed under an event name, I still do not know what procedure it is. Came for a contouring consult only.
rejected.reject_detail: 'diamond v-line hologram' is not in the procedure map

rejected.body_source: 패키지 이름이 시술명을 가림. 보톡스인지 부스터인지 영수증에도 이벤트명만.
rejected.body_en: Package name hid the actual treatment. Receipt only says the event title — botox or booster, unclear.
rejected.reject_detail: '프리미엄 오로라 물광 패키지 맥스' is not in the procedure map

rejected.body_source: 팝에서 김민준 원장에게 코성형. 대기 짧고 결과 만족. (원장 소속은 다른 병원일 수 있음)
rejected.body_en: Rhinoplasty at Pop with Dr. Kim Min-jun. Short wait, happy with the result. (The surgeon may belong to another hospital.)
rejected.reject_detail: kim-minjun is not rostered at pop-ps

rejected.body_source: 윤곽했는데 가격이 상담비처럼 적힘. 본문만 보면 수술 후기임.
rejected.body_en: Had contouring; the price field looks like a consult fee. The write-up is a surgery review.

rejected.body_source: Masseter botox. Someone typed the quote with extra zeros. The actual card charge was normal; this number is junk.
rejected.body_en: Masseter botox. Someone typed the quote with extra zeros. The actual card charge was normal; this number is junk.

rejected.body_source: 상호가 길어서 검색이 안 됨. 강남 어딘가. 코 수술 받았고 만족.
rejected.body_en: The clinic name is so long I cannot search it. Somewhere in Gangnam. Had a nose job, satisfied.

duplicates.body_source: 바노바기에서 매몰 쌍꺼풀. 상담 길고 라인 여러 번 확인. 풀림 가능성 설명 들음. 한쪽이 살짝 덜 접혀서 한 달 뒤 재방문 예정.
duplicates.body_en: Buried-suture double eyelid at Banobagi. Long consult, crease checked repeatedly. Loosening risk explained. One side is slightly shallower; follow-up in a month.

duplicates.body_source: 세 번째 코재수술. 원장이 연골 상태 보여주고 욕심 말라고 함. 호흡이랑 정면 라인 안정. 재수술은 여기.
duplicates.body_en: Third nose revision. Surgeon showed the cartilage and told me not to get greedy. Breathing and front line are stable. Staying here for revisions.

duplicates.body_source: 아이디병원에서 코성형 했습니다. 기증연골로 콧대 올렸고 원장이 과한 디자인은 말렸어요. 붓기 열흘, 일상은 바로. 사진은 각도 아니면 자연스럽습니다.
duplicates.body_en: Rhinoplasty at ID Hospital. Donated cartilage for the bridge. The surgeon talked me out of an aggressive design. Ten days of swelling, daily life immediately. Photos look natural unless you pick the angle.

duplicates.body_source: 두꺼운 눈꺼풀이라 절개. 원장이 근육/지방 스케치로 설명. 흉터는 라인 안쪽. 상담만 받아도 됨.
duplicates.body_en: Thick lids, incisional crease. Surgeon sketched muscle and fat. Scar hidden in the line. Worth the consult alone.
